name: MMedBench
description: MMedBench is a multilingual medical multiple-choice question-answering benchmark with rationale designed to evaluate multilingual medical language models. It supports the development and assessment of medical LLMs across six main languages and includes rationale explanations for answers.
reputation: A specialized multilingual medical QA benchmark that is useful in medical LLM evaluation, though it is less established than major general medical benchmarks.
notes: Includes a large-scale multilingual medical corpus (MMedC) and models; benchmark includes rationale for answers.
